claims.claim_text: The indexed Captain Demetrius G. Stampados is confirmed as the OSS officer described in the 4 May 1944 board proceedings.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The direct OSS report repeats his exact name, captain rank and officer number, adding a precise entry and commissioning chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact full name, rank and the same officer number with a leading-zero formatting difference.
claims.temporal_assessment: The report states OSS entry as a civilian on 11 December 1941 and commission from civilian life in July 1943.
claims.match_notes: The full officer number remains private; the report supplies a direct, person-specific identity bridge.

claims.claim_text: Before coming to the United States and entering OSS, Demetrius G. Stampados had served as an Air Force staff officer in Greece.
claims.evidence_excerpt: where he was a staff officer of the Air Force
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The OSS report describes Greek Air Force staff service and reconnaissance, photo-interpretation, topography and operations training before his U.S. arrival.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact name, rank and officer number in the same direct OSS report.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar military affiliation; the report does not prove it was immediately before OSS and names no civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: Published as an earlier military affiliation, not as a civilian employer or an explicit immediate predecessor.
